_why_one_claim: R only, truth check only (E3); check.py records agreement as untested. RECOVERY asks whether the posterior mean is close to the parameter the fixture used; harness/bayes_examples.test.py adds a Laplace approximation as the oracle.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: the treatment's conditional log odds ratio is 0.6

agreement._note: In place of a second language, harness/bayes_examples.test.py compares the posterior mean and SD with a Laplace approximation (agreement within 0.03 and 10%; observed 0.002 and 0.4%), and requires R-hat below 1.01 and an effective sample size above 1,000 on the committed fixture.

recovery.claim: the posterior mean is close to the fixture's log odds ratio

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: A first fixture of 300 patients missed by 0.65, more than the effect; the fixture uses 1,000. Measured by harness/bayes_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 (MALLARD_SEEDS=100); CI reruns it on seeds 0 to 49 at the same order statistic.
